ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
An electric vehicle starts from rest and travels on a straight, level road. Its v—t graph of motion is shown in the figure.
A. At the end of 12 s, the magnitude of the electric vehicle's acceleration is 1/3 m/s2
B. Within 0~20 s, the average velocity of the electric vehicle is 2.5 m/s
C. Within 0~50 s, the magnitude of the electric vehicle's displacement is 200 m
D. Within 0~50 s, the average velocity of the electric vehicle is greater than 4 m/s

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: An electric vehicle starts from rest and travels on a straight, level road. Its v-t graph of motion is shown in the figure. According to the graph, what is the relationship between the average velocity of the electric vehicle within 0~50 s and 4 m/s?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: Within 0~50s, the average velocity of the electric vehicle is greater than 4m/s
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is the v-t graph of an electric vehicle. The vertical axis is velocity v/(m·s^-1), and the horizontal axis is time t/s. The curve starts rising from t=0, v=0; near t=12 s it reaches v=4 m/s; by t=20 s it reaches v=5 m/s; from 20 s to 50 s the velocity remains on a horizontal straight line at 5 m/s. Reasoning: The average velocity over 0~50 s equals the area under the v-t graph divided by 50 s. Comparing with 4 m/s is equivalent to comparing the area under the graph with the area of a rectangle with height 4 m/s and width 50 s, 4×50. From 20 s to 50 s, the velocity is 5 m/s, so the area exceeding 4 m/s is (5−4)×30=30. Within 0~12 s the curve is below the 4 m/s rectangle, but the graph line lies above the chord connecting (0,0) and (12,4), so the area in this interval is greater than the triangular area 1/2×12×4=24; while the area of the 4 m/s rectangle over 0~12 s is 48, so the deficit relative to 4 m/s in this interval is less than 48−24=24. From 12 s to 20 s, the velocity is at least 4 m/s and gradually increases to 5 m/s, so there is no deficit relative to 4 m/s. The later surplus of 30 over 20~50 s is greater than the earlier deficit of less than 24 over 0~12 s, so the total area over 0~50 s is greater than 4×50. Therefore, the average velocity within 0~50 s is greater than 4 m/s.
